name: codex-feishu
description: Operate and verify the relaxed single-user Windows bridge between Codex tasks and Feishu/Lark topics.

interface.shortDescription: Manage the local Codex and Feishu/Lark task bridge.
interface.longDescription: Provides workflows for installing, checking, testing, deploying, restarting, and diagnosing the relaxed single-user Codex Feishu/Lark bridge. Stable IDs route messages even when bot, project, task, group, or user names change.
defaultPrompt: Check whether the Codex Feishu bridge is healthy.
Verify a Feishu message reached this Codex task.
Deploy and restart the Codex Feishu bridge safely.
